svg.title: Card release results
svg.desc: Release 0.2.0 passed all 44 unit tests. Maintainer browser checks of the exact published JavaScript passed all 24 locales in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The RC fuzz campaigns completed 44,258 render-state and 42,716 unlock-boundary executions. Each target had a 60-second mutation budget. These are synthetic checks, not physical lock tests.

g.text: C: Chromium 156 F: Firefox 157 W: WebKit 27.2
Fuzz executions · 60 s budget per target
Snapshot: 15 October 2026 (Pacific) · all seven files match RC bytes.
Counts describe executed checks, not coverage or device reliability.
